about_the_game:
Squidly wasn’t a hero. He was just a squishy little reef-dweller with more heart than muscle. But when Lord Azure and his Abyssal Cult started dragging folks into the deep and wrecking his home, even a squid has his limits.

Then Poseidon — ancient sea god, part-time drama queen — blessed him with divine power and one mission: get revenge.

Inside this demo, you will experience 30 waves of full gameplay of collecting boss abilities, coming up with different strategies and much more.
